items.name: Ganesh Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Remove obstacles, success in new endeavors, wisdom, prosperity
items.best_time: Pratahkal (Sunrise) or before starting any new work
benefits: Complete removal of all obstacles and impediments in life
Attainment of success and prosperity in all endeavors
Development of wisdom, intelligence, and mental clarity
Protection from all negative forces and dangers
Blessings for new beginnings and ventures
Removal of all fears and anxieties
Attainment of material and spiritual prosperity
Peace and harmony in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman (sipping water) and Sankalpa (declaring intention). Worship Ganesha with 16 steps (Shodashopachara). Offer Modak, Durva grass, and red flowers. Chant the Ganesha mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for removal of obstacles.
items.ideal_for: Those starting new ventures, facing obstacles, or seeking wisdom

items.name: Lakshmi Puja Vidhi
items: Sweets - especially offerings like kheer or payasam
Red cloth - for seating and offering
items.best_time: Pradosh Kaal (Evening), Friday, or Diwali night
benefits: Attraction of immense wealth and prosperity
Abundance in all areas of life
Removal of poverty and financial struggles
Peace and harmony in the family
Attainment of all material and spiritual desires
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Worship Goddess Lakshmi with 16 steps. Offer lotus flowers and gold/silver coins. Chant the Lakshmi mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for wealth and prosperity.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking wealth, prosperity, and financial success

items.name: Durga Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Strength, protection from evil, courage, success
items.best_time: Navratri, Tuesday, or during times of difficulty
benefits: Powerful protection from all negative forces and dangers
Complete removal of all negativity and evil influences
Courage and fearlessness in all situations
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Worship Goddess Durga with 16 steps. Offer red flowers, kumkum, and bael leaves. Chant the Durga mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for protection.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking protection, strength, and courage

items.name: Shiva Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Moksha, destruction of sins, peace, spiritual growth
items.best_time: Brahma Muhurat (4-6 AM), Monday, or Shivratri
benefits: Attainment of Moksha and liberation from the cycle of birth and death
Complete removal of all sins and negative karma
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Shiva
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Abhishekam (ritual bath) of Shiva Linga with milk, water, and panchamrit. Offer bael leaves and dhatura. Chant the Shiva mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for liberation.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking liberation, peace, and spiritual growth

items.name: Vishnu Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Morning, Wednesday, or Vaikuntha Ekadashi
benefits: Establishment of dharma and righteousness in life
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Vishnu
Peace and harmony in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Abhishekam of Vishnu idol with panchamrit. Offer tulsi leaves and yellow flowers. Chant the Vishnu mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for protection.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking prosperity, protection, and spiritual growth

items.name: Saraswati Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Knowledge, wisdom, arts, success in education
items.best_time: Morning, Vasant Panchami, or Wednesday
benefits: Attainment of profound knowledge and wisdom
Development of artistic talents and creativity
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Place books and pens before the goddess. Offer white flowers and white cloth. Chant the Saraswati mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for knowledge.
items.ideal_for: Students, scholars, and those seeking knowledge

items.name: Hanuman Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Strength, courage, devotion, protection from evil
items.best_time: Tuesday morning, Saturday, or Hanuman Jayanti
benefits: Powerful protection from all evil forces
Protection from all dangers and enemies
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer sindoor, red flowers, and banana to Hanuman. Chant the Hanuman mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for strength and protection.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking strength, courage, and protection

items.name: Kali Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Destruction of ego, spiritual liberation, protection
items: Red hibiscus flowers - 108 or as available
items.best_time: Midnight, Tuesday, or Amavasya
benefits: Complete destruction of all evil and negative energies
Attainment of spiritual power and strength
Deep devotion and connection with the Divine Mother
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Worship Goddess Kali with 16 steps. Offer red hibiscus flowers and red cloth. Chant the Kali mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for protection.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking spiritual transformation and protection

items.name: Surya Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Sunrise, facing East
items.procedure: Stand facing the rising sun. Offer water to the sun (Arghya). Offer red flowers, wheat, and jaggery. Chant the Surya mantra 108 times. End with prayer for health and success.
items.chakra_activation: Manipura (Solar Plexus), Ajna (Third Eye), and Anahata (Heart)
items.ideal_for: Those seeking health, success, and vitality

items.name: Kartikeya Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Victory, wisdom, removal of obstacles, courage
items.best_time: Tuesday morning, Krittika Nakshatra, or Thaipusam
benefits: Attainment of victory in all endeavors
Removal of all obstacles and challenges
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Worship Lord Kartikeya with 16 steps. Offer red flowers and honey. Chant the Kartikeya mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for victory.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking victory, wisdom, and removal of obstacles

items.name: Radha Krishna Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Evening, Janmashtami, or Friday
benefits: Attainment of divine love and devotion
Experience of spiritual bliss and inner joy
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Worship Radha-Krishna with 16 steps. Offer tulsi leaves, yellow flowers, and butter. Chant the Krishna mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for love and devotion.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking love, devotion, and spiritual bliss

items.name: Sai Baba Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Peace, miracles, faith, removal of suffering
items.best_time: Thursday morning or any time with devotion
benefits: Attainment of peace and mental tranquility
Experience of miracles and divine grace
Removal of all suffering and difficulties
Peace and harmony in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Apply Udi to forehead. Offer flowers and sweets. Chant the Sai mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for peace.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking peace, miracles, and faith

items.name: Satyanarayan Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Evening, full moon day, or Satyanarayan Vrata
benefits: Fulfillment of all wishes and desires
Peace and harmony in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Abhishekam of Satyanarayan idol. Offer banana leaves and wheat. Chant the Narayana mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for fulfillment of wishes.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking fulfillment of wishes and prosperity

items.name: Griha Pravesh Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Blessing new home, remove Vastu dosha, peace
items.best_time: Auspicious Muhurat, based on astrology
benefits: Attainment of peace and harmony in the home
Happiness and well-being in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Install the Kalash at the entrance. Perform Ganesha Puja first. Worship Vastu Purush with 16 steps. End with Aarti and prayer for peace.
items.ideal_for: New homeowners, those facing Vastu issues

items.name: Vivah Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Marital bliss, prosperity, happy family life
items.best_time: Auspicious Muhurat based on astrology
benefits: Attainment of marital bliss and harmony
Long life and well-being of the spouse
Peace and harmony in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Ganesha Puja first. Worship Vishnu and Lakshmi. Perform the 16 steps of marriage ritual. Chant the mantra for happiness. End with blessings.
items.ideal_for: Couples getting married, those seeking marital bliss

items.name: Griha Shanti Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Peace in home, remove doshas, harmony
items.best_time: Any auspicious day based on astrology
benefits: Attainment of peace and harmony in the home
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Ganesha Puja first. Worship the nine planets with offerings. Perform Homa (fire ritual). End with Aarti and prayer for peace.
items.ideal_for: Those facing planetary issues or seeking peace

items.name: Navagraha Puja Vidhi
items: Nine colored cloths - for each planet
items.best_time: Sunday, during sunrise, or auspicious planetary hour
benefits: Removal of all planetary doshas and afflictions
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Ganesha Puja first. Worship each of the nine planets with appropriate offerings. Perform Homa. End with Aarti and prayer for balance.
items.ideal_for: Those facing planetary issues or seeking balance

items.name: Rudrabhishek Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Removal of sins, blessings, spiritual growth
items.best_time: Monday, during Pradosh Kaal, or Shivratri
benefits: Complete removal of all sins and negative karma
Deep devotion and connection with Lord Shiva
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Abhishekam of Shiva Linga with milk, honey, ghee, and water. Chant the Rudra mantra 11 times. End with Aarti and prayer for liberation.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking liberation, removal of sins, and spiritual growth

items.name: Maha Mrityunjaya Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Any time, especially during illness or times of difficulty
benefits: Excellent health and healing from all diseases
Protection from accidents and untimely death
Removal of all fears and anxieties
Peace of mind and mental strength
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Perform Abhishekam of Shiva Linga with milk and honey. Offer bael leaves and durva grass. Chant the Mahamrityunjaya mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for health.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking health, longevity, and protection

items.name: Baglamukhi Puja Vidhi
items.purpose: Victory over enemies, legal success, protection
items.best_time: Tuesday, during Hora of Mars, or during legal proceedings
items.mantra: Om Hleem Baglamukhi Sarva Dushtanam Vaacham Mukham Padam Stambhaya Jihvaam Keelaya Buddhim Vinashaya Hleem Om Swaha
benefits: Success in legal matters and court cases
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer yellow flowers and turmeric. Chant the Baglamukhi mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for victory.
items.ideal_for: Those facing enemies or legal issues

items.name: Mahalakshmi Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Friday, during Pradosh Kaal, or Diwali
items.mantra: Om Shreem Hreem Shreem Mahalakshmyai Namah
benefits: Attainment of immense wealth and prosperity
Abundance in all areas of life
Removal of poverty and financial struggles
Peace and harmony in the family
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer lotus flowers and gold items. Chant the Mahalakshmi mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for wealth.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking extreme wealth and prosperity

items.name: Kamakhya Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Midnight, during Amavasya, or on Fridays
items.mantra: Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundaye Vichche
benefits: Fulfillment of all desires and wishes
Attainment of tantric powers and abilities
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer red flowers and sindoor. Chant the Kamakhya mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for fulfillment.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking desire fulfillment and spiritual growth

items.name: Chandi Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Navratri, Tuesday, or during times of difficulty
items.mantra: Om Aim Hreem Kleem Chamundaye Vichche
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer red flowers and kumkum. Chant the Chandi mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for protection.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking protection, strength, and courage

items.name: Kaal Bhairav Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Sunday night, during Bhairava Ashtami, or on Tuesdays
items.mantra: Om Hreem Batukaya Aapaduddharanaya Kuru Kuru Batukaya Hreem Om Phat Swaha
benefits: Complete removal of all fears and anxieties
Removal of all obstacles and challenges
Attainment of courage and mental strength
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer black sesame and mustard oil. Chant the Kaal Bhairav mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for protection.
items.ideal_for: Those facing fear, obstacles, or needing protection

items.name: Dhanvantari Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Dhanteras, during Pradosh Kaal, or any time for health
items.mantra: Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya Dhanvantaraye Amritakalasha Hastaaya Sarvamaya Vinashanaya Trailokyanathaya Sri Mahavishnave Namah
benefits: Excellent health and healing from all diseases
Removal of all physical and mental ailments
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer medicinal herbs and tulsi leaves. Chant the Dhanvantari mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for health.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking health, healing, and longevity

items.name: Kuber Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Dhanteras, Friday, or during Pradosh Kaal
items.mantra: Om Yakshaya Kuberaya Vaishravanaya Dhanadhanyadhipataye Dhanadhanyasamriddhim Me Dehi Dapaya Swaha
benefits: Attainment of immense wealth and treasure
Abundance in all areas of life
Removal of poverty and financial struggles
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer gold/silver items and rice. Chant the Kuber mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for wealth.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking wealth, treasure, and financial growth

items.name: Bhairavi Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Tuesday, during midnight, or on Amavasya
benefits: Attainment of spiritual power and strength
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer red flowers and kumkum. Chant the Bhairavi mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for power.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking spiritual power and transformation

items.name: Tara Puja Vidhi
items.best_time: Any time, especially during midnight or Amavasya
items.procedure: Begin with Achaman and Sankalpa. Offer blue flowers and blue cloth. Chant the Tara mantra 108 times. End with Aarti and prayer for wisdom.
items.ideal_for: Those seeking wisdom, protection, and salvation
